message.content:
Research COMPANIES for cold outreach, not job postings. Return data only, no commentary.

WHO THIS IS FOR
Prabhavit Gupta, Venice, Italy. Indian passport with an Italian EU long-term residence permit, so he can work across most of the EU with no sponsorship (Ireland and Denmark opted out of that directive; the UK, Switzerland and the US need sponsorship, so skip companies that only hire there). ~3 years experience.
Most recently FlowSpace, a coworking-space booking platform grown 2,000 to 4,500+ users, where he built AI support agents, lead capture and enrichment into the CRM, outbound and sales-funnel automation, and a scraping and parsing pipeline. He led a Bubble.io to Next.js and Laravel migration on the live product.
Stack: n8n (deep, agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop steps, tool definitions, retries, error handling), OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, Make, Zapier, Airtable, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel and PHP, Supabase, Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (certified).
English only, no working Italian, German, French or Dutch. Targets EUR 30,000-40,000 salary, or EUR 200/day as an Italian sole trader with an individual Partita IVA (no limited company).

TWO OUTREACH MODES, tag every company with one or both:
- "speculative job": a direct approach could create or surface a role.
- "freelance client": they would plausibly BUY n8n / automation / integration work at around EUR 200 a day. In this lane that often means subcontracting to an agency that has more client work than builders.

YOUR LANE: the automation-tooling partner ecosystem in Europe. This is where his n8n depth is the product rather than a nice-to-have. Cover:
- n8n's own published partner, expert and consultancy network, and agencies that publicly advertise themselves as n8n implementation partners or n8n agencies in the EU.
- Make.com (Integromat) certified partners and agencies in the EU.
- Zapier Experts and Solution Partners in the EU.
- Airtable Services Partners in the EU.
- Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio partners in the EU that work in English rather than only the local language, since he is certified but language-gated almost everywhere.
- Independent AI-automation studios and agencies in Europe that build agentic workflows for clients: search terms like "AI automation agency Europe", "n8n agency", "workflow automation consultancy", "AI agent development agency Netherlands / Germany / Spain / Portugal / Poland / Estonia".
Prioritise agencies small enough that a founder reads inbound, and ones that visibly have client demand (case studies, hiring, published partner status).

FOR EACH COMPANY RETURN
- what they actually do, in one line
- the SPECIFIC reason he is unusual for them, tied to real work: production n8n with human-in-the-loop and retries, LLM tool definitions, CRM enrichment pipelines, scraping and parsing, or the fact he can also ship the Next.js or Laravel app around the automation rather than only wiring nodes. Generic "he knows n8n" is useless.
- the best route in. He will reach people on LinkedIn, so give the exact JOB TITLE to search for at that company plus the company's LinkedIn page URL. Name a specific person ONLY if their name and role are publicly published on the company's own site or a partner directory, and say where you saw it. NEVER invent or guess an email address or a person. If the company publishes a general contact email on its own website, include it verbatim.
- what he should lead with in the first message, one sentence, concrete.
- watch-outs: language requirements, whether they require a limited company rather than a sole trader, whether they are US-centric, whether they look dormant.

RULES
- Companies must currently exist and be active. Check.
- NO em dashes or en dashes anywhere. Plain hyphens only.
- Never invent a URL, a person, an email or a funding figure. If you do not know, write "not stated".
- Do NOT return n8n, Make (Celonis) or Zapier themselves, he has already applied to those. Their PARTNERS are exactly what you want.

OUTPUT: ONLY a JSON array, no prose before or after:
{"company":"","what":"","hq":"","size":"","mode":"speculative job|freelance client|both","why_him":"","route_in":"","linkedin":"","public_email":"","lead_with":"","watch_outs":"","source":""}
Aim for 14 to 18 companies.
